name: Fly HV-TMC5160 Plus
description: The Mellow Fly HV-TMC5160 Plus is an external stepper motor driver module that communicates over SPI and is rated for 12-60 V DC input and up to 10 A maximum current — a distinct product from the HV-TMC5160 Pro, with a higher voltage ceiling and a higher current rating. Mellow's documentation describes an FPC cable connection, RGB lighting effect control, and a 12 V fan wiring option, and lists stealthChop2, spreadCycle, dcStep, stallGuard2, and coolStep as the key TMC features, with up to 256 microsteps via the TMC microPlyer step/direction interpolator.
